data.content_ref: inline:The target states that in arid cities 'all incoming solar radiation is converted into sensible heat' because evapotranspiration is suppressed. This is physically false: even with zero latent heat, significant fractions of incoming solar are lost to reflected shortwave (albedo) and outgoing longwave radiation during the day, not stored. Overstating the partition to 100% sensible heat/storage mischaracterizes the energy balance and the magnitude of the nocturnal release.
